customer.offline: You are offline. What you see may be out of date; the app reloads when the connection is back.
customer.noStores: No store takes members yet. Please come back later.
home.declined.purpose: You have not joined. You can still see the stores and the menu, and join at any time.
home.declined.phone: You did not share your phone number, so you have not joined. You can still see the stores and the menu.
home.declined.consent: You did not agree, so you have not joined. Nothing was stored.
home.menuNote: Prices and what is on sale today are at the counter.
home.noProgrammeBody: The shop has no membership programme open yet.
store.missingBody: The store code in the link is no longer used. Choose a store on Home.
legal.privacyTitle: Privacy policy of the Mini App {app}
legal.termsTitle: Terms of use of the Mini App {app}
legal.unavailable: The text could not be loaded. Try again later.
join.purpose.title: Become a member
join.purpose.intro: To collect stamps and points in {programme}, join with your Zalo phone number.
join.purpose.what: Your Zalo phone number, display name and Zalo user id, and your purchases at the shop.
join.purpose.why: To recognise you at the counter, credit stamps and points, and let you earn from a receipt.
join.purpose.howLong: While you are a member and at most {months} months after your last purchase, unless you leave earlier.
join.purpose.zaloAsks: Next, Zalo asks whether you allow sharing your phone number. You can refuse and keep using the app.
join.consent.title: Agree to join
join.consent.loyalty: I agree that {entity} processes my phone number and purchases for the membership programme (required to join).
join.consent.marketingHint: You can stop them at any time under Account.
join.problem.phone-expired: The phone confirmation has expired. Choose Join to try again.
join.problem.policy-outdated: The privacy policy has just changed. Read it again, then choose Join.
join.problem.phone-in-use: This phone number belongs to another Zalo account. Ask the staff at the counter.
join.problem.unknown-store: The store in the link is no longer used. Try again from Home.
join.problem.no-programme: The membership programme is not open for joining right now. You can still browse the stores and menu.
join.closed.title: Joining is not available
join.closed.no-programme: The shop has not opened its membership programme yet, so joining and claiming points from a receipt are not available. You can still browse the stores and menu.
join.closed.no-privacy: The shop has not published its privacy policy yet, so joining and claiming points from a receipt are not available. You can still browse the stores and menu.
join.problem.network: No connection. Check the network and try again.
join.problem.unknown: Joining did not work. Try again in a few minutes.
join.done.title: Welcome!
join.follow.title: Follow the Official Account
join.follow.body: Follow the shop's Official Account to know when stamps and points arrive.
wallet.title: Member card
wallet.notMemberTitle: You are not a member yet
wallet.notMemberBody: Join to collect stamps and points with every purchase.
code.title: Member code
code.intro: Show this code to the cashier before paying. It changes every minute.
code.pickFirst: Choose the store you are buying at to get a code.
claim.title: Earn from a receipt
claim.intro: Did the cashier forget? Enter the receipt number and the total printed on the receipt. Points arrive when the receipt matches the shop's data.
claim.receiptHint: The bill number printed on your receipt (usually 6 digits).
claim.receiptDay: Receipt numbers at this store start with the day of the month ({day} for the date you chose). Check the receipt number or the date on the receipt. You can still send it.
claim.left: You can send {count} more receipts today.
claim.limitReached: You have sent the most receipts allowed today. Try again tomorrow.
claim.problem.receiptInvalid: A receipt number has no spaces and at most 40 characters.
claim.problem.date: This date is outside the claim period.
claim.result.pending.title: Receipt sent
claim.result.pending.body: Points arrive when the shop syncs its receipts, usually within a few minutes.
claim.result.matched.title: Points added
claim.result.matched.body: The receipt matches the shop's data.
claim.result.rejected.title: This receipt was not accepted
claim.reason.amount_mismatch: The total does not match the receipt.
settings.title: Account
settings.notMember: You are not a member. You can see the stores and the menu without sharing anything.
settings.marketingOff: You do not receive promotions. Messages about stamps and points still arrive.
settings.stopConfirmBody: The shop stops sending you promotions at once. Your stamps and points do not change.
settings.deleteBody: You can ask for all your member data to be deleted: the member card, phone number, stamps, points, rewards, receipts sent and the consents on record.
settings.deleteConfirmBody: The request goes to the shop owner. When the owner carries it out, your member card is closed and your data is deleted for good: unused stamps, points and rewards are lost and cannot be restored.
settings.deleteDeadline: The owner carries out the request within the legal deadlines: a reply within 2 working days and the deletion within 20 days (30 days when a data processor is involved).
settings.deleteUntil: Until your data is deleted, you stay a member and can still use your card.
settings.deleteAck: I understand that unused stamps, points and rewards are lost.
settings.deleteReplyBy: The owner replies by {date} at the latest.
settings.deleteDoneBy: Your data is deleted by {date} at the latest.
settings.deleteStateBody.completed: Your member data has been deleted.
settings.deleteStateBody.rejected: The owner did not carry out this request. Ask the staff at the counter why, or send the request again.
settings.language: The app follows Zalo's language setting.
programme.summary: Collect a stamp with every purchase at the counter. A full card of {count} stamps earns a reward at the store.
programme.reward: {count} stamps: a reward at the store.
programme.stampValidity: Stamps are valid for {months} months from the day you get them.
programme.pointsRule: Each receipt also earns points by its value.
join.purpose.howLongPolicy: While you are a member and for the period in the privacy policy, unless you leave earlier.
reward.title: Redeem a reward
reward.intro: Pick a reward and redeem it with stamps or points. The reward code is used at the store you choose.
reward.pickFirst: Choose the store where you will use the reward to see what you can redeem.
reward.empty: This store has no rewards to redeem yet.
reward.kind.free_itemAny: A free item at the counter
reward.ready: You have enough stamps and points for this reward.
reward.reason.already_held: You are holding a code for this reward.
reward.reason.member_limit_reached: You have redeemed this reward as often as allowed.
reward.reason.rail_not_ready: This store does not take this reward yet.
reward.reason.other: This reward cannot be redeemed right now.
reward.confirm.title: Redeem {name}?
reward.confirm.body: You use {cost} to redeem this reward at {store}.
reward.confirm.hold: The code is held for you for {hours} hours. If it is not used by then, the stamps and points go back to your card.
reward.refused.membership_inactive: Your membership card is suspended, so rewards cannot be redeemed.
reward.refused.store_unavailable: This reward cannot be used at the chosen store.
reward.refused.programme_inactive: The membership programme is paused, so rewards cannot be redeemed.
reward.refused.coupon_unavailable: This reward is no longer available.
reward.refused.rail_not_ready: This store does not take this reward yet.
reward.refused.already_held: You are already holding a code for this reward. See it in the voucher wallet.
reward.refused.member_limit_reached: You have redeemed this reward as often as allowed.
reward.refused.insufficient_stamps: You do not have enough stamps for this reward.
reward.refused.insufficient_points: You do not have enough points for this reward.
reward.refused.no_code_available: The store has run out of codes for this reward. Try again later.
reward.refused.other: The reward could not be redeemed. Try again in a few minutes.
voucher.title: Voucher wallet
voucher.empty: You have not redeemed any rewards yet.
voucher.returnedBody: The code was not used, so {cost} went back to your card.
voucher.expiredBody: The hold has ended. {cost} will go back to your card tonight.
voucher.instruction: Show this code to the cashier before you pay. Staff check the code, then apply the reward at the till.
voucher.verified: Staff have checked the code. The reward is confirmed once your receipt is synced.
voucher.missing: This reward code was not found.
voucher.announce.hours: The code has {hours} hours {minutes} minutes left.
voucher.announce.ended: The hold on the code has ended.
claim.result.queued.title: Receipt sent
claim.result.queued.body: Two receipts look the same, so the store checks them and credits the right one.
claim.result.expired.title: Waiting time over
claim.result.expired.body: The receipt was not found in time.
claim.reason.daily_cap: You have sent the most receipts allowed today.
claim.reason.outside_window: The date on the receipt is outside the claim period.
claim.reason.already_earned: This receipt has already earned for a member.
claim.reason.no_matching_invoice: The receipt was not found in time.
claim.reason.invoice_not_completed: The receipt is not completed or was cancelled.
claim.reason.below_minimum: The receipt is below the minimum for a stamp.
claim.reason.excluded_phone: This phone number does not earn under the programme's rules.
claim.reason.excluded_source: Receipts from this sales channel do not earn.
claim.reason.dismissed: The store checked and did not accept this receipt.
wallet.path.bill: By a bill the staff recorded
claim.reason.staff_mode: This store records points through its staff, not from receipts you send. Scan the counter code to get your points.
claim.staffStore: This store records points through its staff. Scan the counter code instead of sending the receipt.
claim.counterHint: Bought at a store with a counter QR code? Scan it to get your points.
bill.title: Confirm your bills
bill.intro: The staff recorded the bills below for you. Type the total you paid so the points are added at once.
bill.totalHint: Type the total printed on the bill. Each bill can be answered once only.
bill.disputeAsk: Bill {bill} is not yours? Its points will be cancelled and the store will look into it.
bill.result.confirmed: Bill {bill} is confirmed. The points are on your card.
bill.result.queued: The total you typed for bill {bill} does not match what the store recorded. A manager will check it; the points are added when the bill is right.
bill.result.waiting: Your answer for bill {bill} is in. The points are added when the store confirms it.
bill.result.reversed: Noted that bill {bill} is not yours. Its points are cancelled and the store will look into it.
bill.refusal.unknown_bill: Bill {bill} is not on your card.
bill.refusal.too_late: The time to confirm bill {bill} has passed.
bill.refusal.other: Bill {bill} could not be confirmed. Ask the staff of the store.
counter.title: Scan the counter code
counter.intro: At a store that records points through its staff, the staff open a QR code at the counter. Scan it, then type the bill number and the total printed on the bill.
counter.scanRefused: Allow Zalo to use the camera to scan the counter code.
counter.notCounter: This is not a counter code. Scan the QR code on the screen of the cashier.
counter.invalid: The code or the bill details are not valid. Scan the counter code again.
counter.result.confirmed.title: Points added
counter.result.confirmed.body: Bill {bill} is recorded and added to your card.
counter.result.awaiting_staff.title: Bill sent
counter.result.awaiting_staff.body: The staff will check bill {bill} before {time}. The points are added when it matches.
counter.result.refused.title: This bill was not accepted
counter.refusal.locked: Too many wrong codes. Try again after {time}.
counter.refusal.code_unknown: This code is not recognised. Scan the QR code showing on the screen of the staff.
counter.refusal.wrong_store: This code is not from a store of the programme. Scan the counter code of the store you bought at.
counter.refusal.not_available: This store does not take counter codes yet. Show your member code to the staff instead.
counter.refusal.code_expired: The counter code has expired. Scan the new code on the screen of the staff.
counter.refusal.code_used: You already used this code. Each code works once; scan a new one.
counter.refusal.daily_limit: You have used counter codes as often as allowed today.
counter.refusal.staff_phone: This phone number does not earn points under the rules of the programme.
counter.refusal.over_bill_limit: The total is above the most one bill may earn. Ask the staff to record it.
counter.refusal.bill_conflict: This bill was recorded with another total. The store will look into it.
counter.refusal.below_minimum: The bill is below the minimum for a stamp.
counter.refusal.store_daily_cap: The store has reached the limit for today. Ask the staff for help.
